# Lisbon 2-Night Stay Planning

A **€260 total budget** for **2 adults** in **central Lisbon** is tight for peak summer dates, so the best fit is usually a compact guesthouse, studio, or budget hotel with flexible terms. Prioritize **location + AC + private bathroom** first, then filter for cancellation flexibility.

## Booking Shortlist for 2026-07-18 to 2026-07-20

- **Location target:** Baixa, Chiado, Rossio, Avenida da Liberdade, or Cais do Sodré edge areas
- **Budget target:** Try to stay at or under **€130 per night total**
- **Must-have filters:** Air conditioning, private bathroom, free cancellation, pay later if possible
- **Policy target:** Look for “free cancellation until 48 hours before check-in” or better
- **Late check-in:** Confirm whether arrival after 21:00 or 22:00 is allowed

## Room Features to Filter For

| Filter | What to select | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| Area | Central Lisbon, walkable to metro/train | Reduces transit time and taxi cost |
| Room type | Double room, studio, or private room | Best value for 2 adults |
| Air conditioning | Yes | Important for July heat |
| Bathroom | Private bathroom | Comfort and privacy |
| Cancellation | Free cancellation until 48 hours before check-in | Matches your flexibility need |
| Payment | Pay later or no prepayment | Protects your budget |
| Check-in | 24-hour front desk or self check-in | Helps with late arrival |
| Wi‑Fi | Included | Useful for navigation and planning |
| Elevator | Preferred if available | Helpful in older Lisbon buildings |
| Noise | Quiet room / courtyard-facing if possible | Central areas can be lively |

## Booking Checklist

- Set dates: **18 Jul 2026 to 20 Jul 2026**
- Set guests: **2 adults**
- Set budget cap: **€260 total**
- Filter for **central neighborhoods**
- Filter for **air conditioning** and **private bathroom**
- Filter for **free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in**
- Sort by **lowest total price**
- Check whether taxes/fees are included
- Review check-in hours and late-arrival rules
- Read recent reviews for cleanliness, AC performance, and noise
- Book only after confirming the cancellation deadline in the final terms

## Message Template for Late Check-in

Hello,

I’m planning to book a stay for **2 adults** from **18 July 2026 to 20 July 2026**. Before I confirm, could you please let me know if **late check-in** is possible?

Our expected arrival time may be after **[insert time]**. Please also confirm:
- Your latest check-in time
- Whether self check-in is available
- Any instructions for arriving late
- If the room has **air conditioning** and a **private bathroom**
- Your cancellation policy, specifically whether changes are allowed up to **48 hours before check-in**

Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
[Your name]
